component.name: Segmenter
component.summary: Visual timestamp annotation and automatic segment detection

description.p: Segmenter detects, edits and submits video segment markers — Intro, Recap, Credits and Preview — to TheIntroDB and IntroDB. Season fingerprinting cross-correlates the audio of every episode in a folder to locate recurring intros and credits automatically, with an optional visual pass that tells closing credits apart from a next-episode preview.

ul.li: Frame-accurate LibVLC playback with hardware decoding
Zoomable multi-track timeline with direct segment editing
Four RCD detection methods, from pure audio to multimodal audio+vision fusion
Real-time frame strip for precise boundary placement
Full TheIntroDB v3 API submission support

description.p: Native Qt 6 / C++ Linux port, sharing its application core with the Windows build.
